insight: Multi-Entity Consistency: feed 3–7 reference images of characters or objects and it keeps them consistent across the generated clip.
name: Vidu
tagline: Text-, image-, and reference-to-video generation at up to 1080p.
description: An AI video generator from Tsinghua-spinout Shengshu Technology. Turns text prompts, still images, or reference images into short high-resolution clips, with text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video modes. Known for fast, low-cost generation and keeping multiple uploaded subjects consistent across a shot.
